title: Observer ACL Enforcement
purpose: Make RegulatoryObserver read-only by access control, not by endorsement arithmetic

before_fix.vulnerability: Regulator could write by getting 2 endorsing peers to sign (demonstrated)
before_fix.error_message: ProposalResponsePayloads do not match (when trying with only regulator endorsement)

test1_anchor_commitment.error_message: access denied: RegulatoryObserverMSP is not authorized to perform write operations

test2_record_loan_event.error_message: access denied: RegulatoryObserverMSP is not authorized to perform write operations

test3_read_commitment.note: Regulator can still query all data

acl_configuration.mechanism: MSP ID check in checkWriteAccess() function
acl_configuration.quotable_code: if !endorsingMSPs[mspID] { return fmt.Errorf("access denied: %s is not authorized to perform write operations", mspID) }
defense_depth: 2. Chaincode ACL rejects RegulatoryObserver submissions (application level)

embedded_supervision_compliance.auer_2022_requirement: Regulator has real-time visibility without transaction authority

implementation.enforcement: Application-level access control, not just policy arithmetic

summary.before: Regulator blocked by signature count (could bypass with endorser cooperation)
summary.after: Regulator blocked by explicit ACL (cannot bypass regardless of endorsements)
